newsitem.title: NORWAY: Awilco says UK Foinaven oil start up in a "few weeks.
newsitem.headline: Awilco says UK Foinaven oil start up in a "few weeks.

text.p: Norwegian offshore services group Awilco ASA said on Thursday it had completed the final tie in of the Petrojarl production vessel at the UK Foinaven oilfield west of Shetlands, but production would not begin for a "further few weeks".
"After completing the final riser tie-in during Easter, the 'Petrojarl Foinaven' is ready to receive oil," Awilco said in a statement.
"However, British Petroleum has now informed Awilco that the company shall need a further few weeks before they are able to start production."
Foinaven, the first oilfield developed in UK Atantic margin waters west of Scotland's Shetland islands, was originally scheduled to come onstream in June 1996.
But a series of technical mishaps have delayed the project by almost a year.
Awilco said the latest hiccup was due to bad weather conditions disrupting final testing and commissioning of the subsea system via use of remotely-operated vehicles.
The company said it would continue to receive dayrate to cover direct costs until the subsea system is ready. The subsea work is managed and paid for by BP, it said.
